review_notes: I read the whole target file and the defining file HigherBiasSourceWordDefs.lean (rolePrior, binMean, bins, wordLog). I also read HigherBiasSourceWordStatistic.lean, which uses the same pattern. Neither file declares any simp lemmas for `rolePrior`. I did not run Lean. The `simp only` calls in `sum_binMean` and `common_bin` look adequate locally, so I report only the missing-simp-lemma pattern. The proposed lemma names are suggestions and have not been compiled.

findings.declaration: sum_binMean (final simp only on rolePrior); related: rolePrior in HigherBiasSourceWordDefs.lean
findings.problem: `rolePrior` is a plain def built from `Fin.append`. It has no canonical simp lemmas for its two cases, `rolePrior bulk top m (Fin.castAdd 1 i) = bulk` and `rolePrior bulk top m (Fin.natAdd m 0) = top`. Every use therefore unfolds the definition and then rewrites with the generic `Fin.append_left` / `Fin.append_right`. The same unfold-and-append pattern is repeated in at least four places: this file, HigherBiasSourceWordDefs.lean (`simpa only [rolePrior,Fin.append_left]` and `simpa only [rolePrior,Fin.append_right]`), and `rolePrior_eq` in HigherBiasSourceWordStatistic.lean. Unfolding `rolePrior` exposes the `Fin.append` implementation to every caller. It is also fragile: `simp only [rolePrior]` with the append lemmas has to fire on exactly the right terms.
findings.proposed_change:
In HigherBiasSourceWordDefs.lean, right after `rolePrior`, add two `@[simp]` lemmas (the names `rolePrior_castAdd` and `rolePrior_natAdd` are my suggestion):
`rolePrior bulk top m (Fin.castAdd 1 i) = bulk` and `rolePrior bulk top m (Fin.natAdd m (0 : Fin 1)) = top`. Each should be proved once by `simp [rolePrior]`, using `Fin.append_left` / `Fin.append_right`. Then the final step in `sum_binMean` becomes `simp only [rolePrior_castAdd, rolePrior_natAdd, Finset.prod_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin, pow_one]`. The same lemmas shorten the other three call sites, and `rolePrior` can stay opaque to callers.
findings.benefit: Callers get one canonical rewrite for each role, and no `Fin.append` implementation detail leaks. The duplicated unfold-and-append `simp only` lists collapse into plain lemma references. A later change to the definition of `rolePrior` then needs edits in one place only.

evidence.excerpt: Fin.append (fun _ : Fin m => bulk) (fun _ : Fin 1 => top)
